state.paragraph: On December 10, PetSmart received final bid letters along with revised versions of the merger agreement and other transaction documents from the Buyer Group and from Bidder 2 and a verbal indication from Bidder 3. The Buyer Group offered $80.70 per share, in cash, and Bidder 2 offered $80.35 per share, in cash. Bidder 3 verbally communicated to J.P. Morgan that their valuation would not be above the current stock price of approximately $78 per share. J.P. Morgan communicated to Bidder 3 that it was unlikely to be competitive and accordingly Bidder 3 did not submit a written offer. The form of merger agreement and other transaction documentation submitted by the Buyer Group were more favorable to the Company (including because they were less conditional and more likely to be completed and because they offered more certainty of protection for the Company in the unlikely event of non-completion of the transaction) and reflected substantially more acceptance of the Company's positions. Each bidder indicated that its bid was not dependent on a rollover by Longview, but neither the Buyer Group nor Bidder 2 ruled out the possibility of partnering with Longview in a transaction, though Bidder 2 indicated that any partnering with Longview would only occur after completion of bidding and execution of a definitive merger agreement with the Company.

ledger_rows.Note: Final bids initially due Friday 12/05/2014, with completion targeted 12/15. In November form merger agreement circulated with instruction to submit comments together with final bids.
Final-bid due date moved from 12/05 to evening of 12/10 to shorten post-bid period and leak risk; bidders asked to send markups and financing commitments in advance.

Final bid letter with revised merger agreement and transaction documents. Financing commitment documents supplied 12/06. Documents less conditional than Bidder 2’s. Not dependent on Longview rollover.

Final bid letter with revised merger agreement and transaction documents; documents more conditional than Buyer Group’s; financing status not reported until 12/12. Would partner with Longview only after signing.
Final-bid due date (evening). Two written bids received; Bidder 3 gave only a verbal valuation.
Verbal valuation not above the ~$78 stock price; J.P. Morgan said it was unlikely to be competitive, so no written offer. Both sides contributed. Not mentioned again.
Neither bid acceptable unless improved: J.P. Morgan told both bidders to raise their bids, improved bids due 12/12. Treated as an extension within the final round, not a new round.

Rollover permitted: committee approved Buyer Group’s request to work with Longview; confidentiality agreement shared bid price. Bidder 2 would consider rollover only post-signing. Both bidders met Longview 12/09 without disclosing prices.
Revises #30. Confirmed to J.P. Morgan as best and final; with revised merger agreement drafts and financing commitment documents.
Revises #29. Oral offer; said it was working to raise it within hours. Financing commitments already provided.

Revises #36. Best and final; revised drafts “with few exceptions” in executable form, plus financing commitments. Longview’s $250 million rollover support helped reach $83.00; members unwilling or unable to go higher.
Due date for improved bids; both remaining bidders submitted that evening.
Board selected Buyer Group: approved merger at $83.00 cash, subject to resolving remaining open points in the agreement; J.P. Morgan gave fairness opinion.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

exit.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a potential buyer withdraws, declines to bid, is told it will not advance, or is otherwise excluded from the process. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
